description: This file defines the AgentFieldHandler class responsible for managing communication between an agent and the AgentField server, including registration, heartbeats, fast lifecycle management, signal handling, and shutdown notifications.

classes.name: AgentFieldHandler
classes.description: Handles communication with the AgentField server, including registration, heartbeats, fast lifecycle, and signal handling.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the handler with an agent instance.

methods.name: register_with_agentfield_server
methods.description: Registers the agent with the AgentField server, handling callback URL resolution and server registration.

methods.name: send_heartbeat
methods.description: Sends a simple heartbeat to the server.

methods.name: heartbeat_worker
methods.description: Background thread that periodically sends heartbeats.

methods.name: send_enhanced_heartbeat
methods.description: Sends an enhanced heartbeat with status and MCP info.

methods.name: notify_shutdown
methods.description: Notifies the server of a graceful shutdown.

methods.name: setup_fast_lifecycle_signal_handlers
methods.description: Sets up signal handlers for fast shutdown via SIGTERM.

methods.name: register_with_fast_lifecycle
methods.description: Registers the agent with immediate status reporting for fast lifecycle.

methods.name: enhanced_heartbeat_loop
methods.description: Background loop for sending enhanced heartbeats at intervals.
